name: Promo
description: Someone takes the microphone and talks to the crowd, an opponent or the camera.

name: Interview
description: A backstage or ringside interviewer asks the questions and the talent answers.

name: Confrontation
description: Rivals come face to face. Words are traded and it may not stay peaceful.

name: Attack
description: An ambush in the ring, backstage or in the car park. Few words, lots of impact.

name: Contract Signing
description: A table, a contract and two people who do not like each other. It rarely ends with just a signature.

name: Video Package
description: A pre-recorded piece that builds a rivalry or introduces someone new.
